# Mystherie - Tea Atelier

> Mystery tea collections. Limited batches. Curated blends.

Mystherie is a specialty tea brand offering limited-batch mystery tea collections. Each collection is a curated blend of herbs, teas, and botanicals with a secret recipe. Customers know the general flavor profile, effect type, caffeine status, and allergen information, but the exact blend remains a surprise. When a batch sells out, it's gone forever.

- [Home](https://mystherie.com/): Browse current limited-edition tea collections

## Key Concepts

- **Mystery Collections**: Limited-run tea blends with undisclosed recipes. General profile (flavor, effect, caffeine) is shared; exact ingredients are the surprise.
- **Batch Model**: Each collection has a fixed quantity (typically 10-30 units). Once sold out, that blend is retired.
- **Ingredient Library**: Blends draw from 45+ curated ingredients spanning Japanese green teas, Haitian herbal remedies, Indian chai, European blends, and more.
- **Transparency**: Caffeine status, allergen warnings, steep guides, and effect types are always disclosed.
